text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey has brought me along to
a store
in the mall.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Sooo, I need something to keep my fan
letters
in. ♪
choice_data_list: それで何が買いたいんだっけ？

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I've been getting letters from all kinds of
people
lately, and those letters don't fit
in the box in my
room anymore.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Feng shui actually says it's better to get
rid of
letters after a certain amount of
time. But there
are some exceptions.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If you have letters that make you feel
happy, or if
they're from people who
mean a lot to you, it's
okay to keep
them as long as you store them

somewhere that gets a lot of sunlight.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I want to cherish all the letters my fans
have sent
me. ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
One of them said, "I don't really
understand feng
shui, but your running
made me feel so much
better."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And another letter was from a fan who
talked
about how I inspired her to start
learning about
feng shui!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hearing what my fans have to say gives
me so
much strength!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪ The color, the shape, and the breathability of the material are all perfect! I'll put my fan letters in this as soon as I get back to my room!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's pretty big, but once this basket's
full, I'm
going to have to get an even
bigger one.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh! But what will I do if I get so many
fan letters
that my whole room fills up?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh! My dad might have some good
ideas! Maybe
I'll ask him the next time
we talk.
choice_data_list: リッキーならそう遠くない未来に実現しそう

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Well... I'll have to figure something out,
but if I
end up with that many people
supporting me, it's
going to be one
happy day!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like imagining a bright future has
boosted
Copano Rickey's motivation
even higher.
